description: ISA-95 Part 2 cl. 5.4 (personnel model) Person: one person, by a pseudonymous number only. No name and no personal data (owner 07.10., OPEN-0330 P8-a): names stay in the source system (HR / MES).

properties.name: person_id
properties.description: Pseudonymous identity of the person from the source system — never a name, badge or personnel number that identifies the person outside it.

properties.name: personnel_class_ref
properties.description: The personnel class of the person (DEFINED_BY).

relationships.description: The personnel class of the person (B2MML Person.PersonnelClassID).

isa95.note: ISA-95 Part 2 cl. 5.4 Person. B2MML PersonName is deliberately not modelled (no personal data in the UNS).
